newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X to issue more news, resume trade - TSE.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X to issue more news, resume trade - TSE.

text.p: Trading in Bre-X Minerals Ltd will resume on Tuesday morning after dissemination of additional news by the company, the Toronto Stock Exchange said on Monday.

It said that in a Bre-X news release today, "the company said new material information will be available from a report by (assay company) Kilborn and has undertaken to issue a news release before the opening of the market tomorrow."

Bre-X shares tumbled on Thursday after Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc, the new partner of the Calgary-based mining exploration company, said samples it had drilled and tested from Bre-X's Indonesian property contained "insignificant" amounts of gold.
On Thursday, sellers hacked almost C$3.0 billion off Bre-X's market value when the stock resumed trading on the TSE after being halted for most of the session.
Bre-X has said it stands behind its claim to have found the richest gold strike in the world at Busang on the island of Borneo.
